libs.note: BH-9154 semantic rungs of patch_same_review (review callers only): patch_same_semantic answers `lockfile` when two heads differ only in named lockfiles that install the same code (package-lock.json only: the same packages, versions, resolved URLs and integrity on both heads, every resolved host in PATCH_SAME_LOCK_HOSTS; sibling package.json diff byte-equal; status M, never added or deleted; mode 100644; the commit author is never the permission) and `whitespace` when they differ only in trailing end-of-line whitespace outside PATCH_SAME_WS_SIGNIFICANT, never after a `\`. Byte callers (CI and test result reuse) stay on patch_same. Note: docs/notes/2026-11-06-BH-9154-patch-same-rungs.md.

knobs.note: Space list of lockfile basenames the lockfile rung may drop. Set and empty turns the rung off. Only package-lock.json has a parser: any other named lockfile that differs is rc 1. A lockfile-named path with a space or other unsafe byte is never dropped (rc 1). Read as ${PATCH_SAME_LOCKFILES-package-lock.json}.

Space list of registry hosts. Every non-link `resolved` in the new head's lockfile must be an https URL on one of these hosts, or the lockfile rung is rc 1. Set and empty allows no host. Read as ${PATCH_SAME_LOCK_HOSTS-registry.npmjs.org}.

Space list of extensions (leading dot) and exact basenames where trailing whitespace is content; those files are compared byte for byte by the whitespace rung. Read as ${PATCH_SAME_WS_SIGNIFICANT-.py .yml .yaml .md .mk Makefile .patch .diff .tsv}.
